name: 11219 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11219 (Brooklyn) has 1,286 nonprofit organizations. 149 of them (12%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 121 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11219 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
